hero.imageAlt: Illustrated shopfront under a Spanish and British flag sign, with a Welcome banner and a group of members holding flags from many countries
hero.sentence: A free Discord server where Spanish and English speakers help each other learn, every day since {{year}}.

intro.title: One server, two languages
intro.lead: Everyone here is learning Spanish or English, and many speak the other one natively. So every conversation is an exchange: you get help in the language you want and give it in the one you know.

who.title: Who.
who.body: Learners and native speakers from Spain, Latin America, the United States, the United Kingdom and everywhere between. Every level is welcome, from first words to fluent.

what.title: What.
what.body: Ask how something is said, get advice on grammar and vocabulary, talk in the voice channels, or just chat. Language exchange and casual conversation, in both languages.

where.title: Where.
where.body: On Discord, since November 2016, as a Discord Partner server. With members in every time zone, someone is always around to answer.

how.title: How.
how.body: It's free. You need a Discord account, in the app or the browser. Open discord.gg/spanish-english, accept the rules, and you're in.

one.body: It works in the Discord app or straight in your browser.

two.body: New members wait ten minutes before their first message.

three.body: A few questions tell others your language and your level.

four.body: Write in the language you're learning. Someone who speaks it will answer.

resources.title: Between conversations
resources.body: Things to listen to and watch that the community recommends, each marked with its language and level.

free.a: Yes. Joining the server costs nothing, and neither does a Discord account.

level.q: Do I need to speak already?
level.a: No. Members range from complete beginners to native speakers. Say your level when you join and people will meet you there.

variety.a: All of them. Members come from Spain and across Latin America, the United States, the United Kingdom and beyond, so you'll hear different accents and different words for the same thing.

wait.q: Why can't I post straight away?
wait.a: The server uses Discord's high verification level: your account needs a verified email and must be at least five minutes old, and you need to have been in the server for ten minutes. It keeps spam out.

voice.q: Do I have to use voice?
voice.a: No. You can stay in text the whole time. The voice channels are there when you want to practise speaking.

age.q: How old do I have to be?
age.a: Discord's own minimum: 13 in most countries, older in some. The server follows Discord's terms.

cta.title: Your turn to talk
cta.beforeNoCount: Thousands of people are already practising.
